facts.fact: The Bank of Namibia issued Determination PSD-1 under section 45 of the Payment System Management Act, 2023 (Act 14 of 2023), effective on Gazette publication on 6 January 2026 (Gazette 8822, signed 19 December 2025).
PSD-1 (2026) sets a licensing process for payment services by non-bank financial institutions (paragraph 8) and defines an electronic money issuer as a licensed payment service provider.
